svg.title: Tarun Diwedi — UI/UX Designer × Game Developer
svg.desc: A glowing spellbook floats in a starry night sky among candles while a magic wand writes the name Tarun Diwedi in gold. UI/UX designer and game developer, available for freelance and full-time work worldwide.

g.text: I conjure interfaces in Figma and enchant them into playful web games.
